description: Validate a PDF template DSL script for structure, tag/style correctness, and accessibility issues. Runs catalog validation plus alt-text checks. Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue has severity 'error', and a script that fails to execute comes back as a single 'dsl-execution' error rather than a tool error. Mirrors POST /api/v1/preview/validate.

data.description: Optional binding data. Falls back to the script's sampleData when omitted.

dsl.description: The builder DSL script to validate. Must assign `const template = doc(...)`.

name: validate_dsl

issues.description: Every problem found, errors and warnings together.

message.description: What is wrong and, usually, how to fix it.

path.description: Location in the document tree (e.g. 'kids[0].kids[2]'); empty when it applies to the whole document.

rule.description: Identifier of the check that raised the issue.

valid.description: False when any issue has severity 'error'; warnings alone leave it true.

title: Validate template DSL
